screens.label: Profile
screens.prompt:
Create exactly ONE polished desktop application screenshot of the NEXG merchant workspace, continuing the supplied Business reference. The reference is the authoritative style and shared shell, not an edit target. Match its near-black sidebar, gold NEXG wordmark, dark-gray selected row with thin gold left border, warm cream page, white header, white rounded panels, fine neutral dividers, readable compact sans-serif text, and restrained gold action buttons. Keep identical shell geometry in every screenshot. Sidebar labels in exact order: Home, Work, Offerings, Availability, Business SELECTED, Money, Promotions, Insights, Settings. Header: Merchant workspace, Sample preview badge, All locations, notification bell, Help, NC avatar. No browser chrome, device frame, captions outside UI, collage, decorative charts, giant whitespace or cut-off content. One landscape screen around 16:9, with all relevant visible details and bottom actions fitting comfortably. Use fictional sample data consistently: Nairobi Collective has configured salon services and beauty product sales; home visits are a draft awaiting service-area setup. Westlands studio offers salon services plus products; Kilimani shop offers products. All operational UI data is fictional sample data. Keep account/security/preferences/API credentials/payment configuration in the separate Settings/Money screens. Main heading Business, subtitle Nairobi Collective; a compact summary says Account approved, 2 configured activities, 1 activity setup task. Then six section tabs, exactly: Profile, Activities & setup, Locations & coverage, Team, Documents, Customer feedback. Select ONLY the requested section, keep every other tab reachable. Show one coherent populated state with relevant controls enabled, not all dropdowns or dialogs opened. Avoid duplicated facts/sections and misleading verification claims. This is a proposed design screenshot, not evidence of a working app.

SELECT PROFILE. A white main panel titled Public profile fills about 60%, with a narrower white customer-preview panel on the right. Compact edit form: brand mark square NC with Change logo action; Trading name input Nairobi Collective; short description textarea 'Salon services and beauty essentials in Nairobi.'; Public email hello@nairobijcollective.example; public contact label 'Phone ending 0482' with Change contact link; customer-facing activities chips Salon services and Beauty product sales; location links Westlands studio and Kilimani shop. Preserve adequate spacing but fit all on screen. A clearly separate compact section Registered identity shows 'Managed through account review' and Request change, with no personal ID numbers or tax numbers. Right preview headed Customer view shows NC logo, Nairobi Collective, description, two configured activity labels, 'Westlands · Kilimani', and a View public profile link. No invented star rating or verified-professional badge on public preview. Beneath the form a subdued note 'Public profile changes do not alter active bookings.' Footer secondary Cancel and gold Save profile. Keep the sample preview label obvious.
